items.state: removable complete perch plus aligned foreground lip
items.baseline: Contact-surface line at pivot Y; art extends below surface naturally
items.required_body_pose: Round low dark-blue cushion with canonical brass edging; stable flat contact surface for all six companion silhouettes. No baked pet, crystal, glow or labels.

interaction_metadata.measurement_method: Trace only actual front rim visible pixels on final matching front PNG. It may cover lower contact toes/underside only, never face/Core; anchor line passes through the actual flat cushion/shelf contact surface.

acceptance_criteria: Matches the exact dedicated identity/registered entity panel; no species, silhouette, colour, marking, outfit or proportion redesign
Exact independently authored state and facing; not an idle/strike renamed to fill another cell
Required canvas, full silhouette, clean straight-alpha RGBA, no text/background; uniform scaling only
Measured anchor sidecar and matching co-registered layers; no guessed palms or reconstructed occluded anatomy
Native phone 1080x2340 and tablet 1200x1920 review at actual presentation scale; hands, feet, tails and equipment remain readable
Register only exact approved state/facing/family after parser/canonical guard/weapon-fit review; preserve existing gameplay clocks, balance, saves and touch behaviour
Cushion/ledge reads as approved Home furnishing, no new character identity
Contact anchor meets actual visible upper surface; front layer pixel-identical/aligned with body front rim
96x48 design presentation complete and readable; no duplicate baked background prop
Removing/switching pet does not reveal missing background pixels
rejection_criteria: Identity drift or use of rejected boards
Missing/doubled/warped anatomy, clipped silhouette, hidden or floating contact
Baked interchangeable equipment, labels, shadows or temporal FX
Wrong canvas/path/sidecar, inferred contact pixels or placeholder/reference card
Native staging, fit or face-target failure; technically valid PNG is not visual acceptance
importer_registration_work_required: Add reusable prop/lip layering and catalogue registration only after accepted export
Consume safe-area Home slots and persistence contract below; current code does not support these yet
